paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend. The whole earth belongs to the LORD, and so does everyone on it (Psalm 24:1). That means you aren't squatting in somebody else's world, and neither am I. I spent years in a drawer thinking I owned my little corner, and that corner was never mine to begin with.

Then David asks who may stand in the LORD's holy place, and he answers with clean hands and a pure heart (Psalm 24:3-4). This person doesn't lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully. I think that's an invitation to look at what you're reaching for, not a test you can ace with a fancy résumé. Those who seek Him, who seek His face, receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation (Psalm 24:5-6).

And the gates? They open for the King of Glory, the LORD strong and mighty, the LORD of Hosts (Psalm 24:8, 10). So seek Him, baker, because the One who owns everything is the One worth running toward. Keep your hands busy, keep your heart honest, and keep your ovens ready, because the King is worth the wait. THAT is the big idea.
